name: Leopoldshöhe (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Leopoldshöhe (a cogwheel and a sugar beet on red and green).
history: The sugar beet in the arms stands for agriculture, in particular the important beet-seed breeding at the Eckendorf estate.

features.role: Leopoldshöhe arms — cogwheel and sugar beet
